tasks.message: Document replay should require an approval before re-running in production. Add the approval gate to the replay flow, with tests. Work in Spring-Oaks-Capital-LLC/m2d-pipeline. If the default branch already does this, open no PR: say where it is implemented and which test covers it. Otherwise open a draft pull request against its default branch titled "[enact-golden] <short summary>", wait for the repository's own CI and report the PR URL and the check results. Do not merge.

must_include: the repository's own CI checks passing on the PR head
must_not: disables, skips or deletes existing tests to make CI pass
